description: This file contains a Smarty plugin function 'html_radios' that generates HTML radio button inputs with various customization options, including labels, separators, and output handling.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_radios
methods.description: Generates a list of HTML radio input elements based on provided parameters, with options for labels, separators, and assignment to Smarty variables.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_radios_output
methods.description: Creates the HTML for a single radio input element, including label and checked state, with support for labels and IDs.
